# 點解 …？ · *dim2 gaai2 …?*

**Meaning:** why · **Level:** A2 · **Topic:** Asking questions

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [open an issue](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new).

點解 can go at the start of the question or after the subject. Answers usually begin with 因為 (because). Ending with 㗎 adds a note of puzzlement.

**Written Chinese:** 為甚麼 — Written Chinese uses 為甚麼.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **你點解學廣東話呀？** |
| Jyutping | nei5 dim2 gaai2 hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 aa3? |
| Yale | néih dím gáai hohk gwóng dūng wá a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄉㄧㆬ² ㄍㄚㄧ² ㄏㄛㆶ⁶ ㄍㄨㄛㄥ² ㄉㄨㄥ¹ ㄨㄚ² ㄚ³? |
| English | Why are you learning Cantonese? |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **點解佢唔嚟呀？** |
| Jyutping | dim2 gaai2 keoi5 m4 lai4 aa3? |
| Yale | dím gáai kéuih m̀h làih a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄉㄧㆬ² ㄍㄚㄧ² ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㆬ⁴ ㄌㄜㄧ⁴ ㄚ³? |
| English | Why isn't he coming? |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **點解咁貴㗎？** |
| Jyutping | dim2 gaai2 gam3 gwai3 gaa3? |
| Yale | dím gáai gam gwai ga? |
| Bopomofo | ㄉㄧㆬ² ㄍㄚㄧ² ㄍㄜㆬ³ ㄍㄨㄜㄧ³ ㄍㄚ³? |
| English | Why is it so expensive? |
